invariants.rationale: The method promises to return a HoodieWriteMetadata object; a null result would indicate an error.
The method is expected to process a list of records; null would likely be handled prior to this call.
instantTime is required to identify the commit instant; it is likely expected to be non-null.
context is necessary for the engine operations; a null context would not allow execution.
The returned HoodieWriteMetadata is expected to contain a non-null write status list.
